text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hello. Are you two heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well, actually…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you free right now, Yaeno? Would you care to join us for some tea?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We were just on our way back from the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: They wanted to check how our injuries are healing up.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see. And what did they say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm healing. However… it appears the day I can return to the track is still rather distant.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I asked when I'll be able to race again, but the doctor couldn't give me a straight answer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There is no use in dwelling upon it. For now, we need to focus on recovering until we are fit to run again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: … It's not like anyone's waiting for me, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How can you say something like that?! Of course they are!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But how many people are really going to remember my name when I'm not racing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The longer I'm off the track, the more distant a memory I become.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What about me?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The three of us fought for the Classic Triple Crown! If I continue racing…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Each time I run, everyone will remember you two as well!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will save your places on the turf! As long as I run, no one will forget about either of you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, aren't you dependable?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The two of us will do our part and focus on our recovery. Isn't that right, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Sorry for getting all mopey back there…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to heal up, so wait a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will! For as long as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I want to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki scores high in the popularity poll for the Arima Kinen. When I ask her if she wants to run in it, she answers yes without hesitation.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you'll be okay with the distance?
Are you sure you'll be okay with the distance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is 2,500 meters, so I'm concerned about her endurance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I understand your concern, but I have made up my mind.
choice_data_list: Is there a special reason you want to run there?
Is there a special reason you want to run there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's rare to see her insist on something like this, so I can't help but ask.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Actually…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki tells me about her promise to keep Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan alive in people's hearts by competing herself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is the culmination of the entire year, so I thought that would make it the ultimate place to refresh everyone's memories.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To be honest… without a strong obsession, I'm not sure if I have what it takes to perform such a big feat.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But I know that if I'm going to run, I must pour every ounce of energy I have into it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm also thinking of the other racers I know will be competing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As a Classic Triple Crown competitor, I have no choice but to face them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The stands are packed with fans who have come to witness the showdown between Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The air here is even more electric than at the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's always a blessing to have an audience, whatever the reason may be.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Tamamo Cross! Show us your white lightning today!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: You're da strongest, Tamamo! Don't give 'em an inch!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Go, Oguri Cap! Show everyone what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: They sound like a raging storm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (But I can't let it shake me. I must stay focused.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I have to put my worries aside and hone my fierce blaze with the stillness of water.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's time!
